## Orientation

Inline task. The ruff autofix touches many files that in-flight phases may edit. Land it first.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/ci-workflow--ci-ruff-clean`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R13: `pyproject.toml` configures ruff with rule set `F` only.
R14: `ruff check` exits 0 on the repository.

## Approach

Add `[tool.ruff.lint]` with `select = ["F"]` to `pyproject.toml`. Run `uvx ruff@0.13.1 check --fix .`. Fix the remaining F841 and F811 errors by hand with the smallest edit. Keep every change behavior-neutral. Run the affected test files with `uv run pytest <files>`, then `scripts/test.sh`. Commit on the phase branch.
